headline: Georgian Court finish the season with the most wins
dek: Georgian Court closed the season by winning at Bridgeport, who had beaten them on their own ground in October. Their twelve wins, against three draws and six defeats, belong to a side that finished mid-table, where only meetings between members count.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 49 and conceded 41, in a season of nine wins, three draws and eight defeats.

wire.line: Goldey-Beacom finish with one win all season, and it came against a non-conference side.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored eleven goals for Georgian Court from 81 shots, and has eight assists.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept nine shutouts for Felician and conceded twelve goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 58 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed

last_match.line: Georgian Court have not lost since Jefferson beat them in October; Bridgeport had won at Holy Family and at Wilmington on the way in.
